name: field
title: Field
description: Connects a label, a control, a hint and an error with the right ids and ARIA.
a11y: The label is bound to the control by id, so it has an accessible name.
Hint and error are linked with aria-describedby; an error sets aria-invalid and is announced via role=alert.
required sets the native required attribute on the control.
Inside a Form with errors, a Field with a matching name shows that error once; the form summary announces it, so the inline text is not a second alert.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label of the control. Required so every control has a name.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text shown under the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Error message. Its presence marks the control invalid and it is announced politely. Inside a `Form` with `errors`, leave it out and set `name` instead.

props.name: name
props.description: The `name` of the control. Inside a `Form` that has `errors`, the Field shows the message for this name, so you pass each error once.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the control as required: adds a required marker to the label and sets `required` on the control. Default false.

props.name: children
props.description: The control: Input, Textarea, Select trigger, etc.

usage: import {Field, Input} from '@monoline/react';
